'''Bogwing Brake''' was the name given to the region of the [[Minimum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that was located just north of [[Prisoner Intake]] but south of the [[Prison Administration Center]]. It was named for the numerous [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwings]] that made their home there.
